newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Colonial to offer 153 mln shares in float.
newsitem.headline: Colonial to offer 153 mln shares in float.

text.p: Insurance and banking group Colonial Ltd said on Thursday it would offer 153 million shares to the public at a retail price of A$2.60 each in its planned share market float.
Institutions would be offered the shares in a price range of A$2.50 to A$2.90 in an open price book building tender.
The offered shares are in addition to the around 422 million shares already issued to policy-holders under the group's demutualisation plan.

Colonial plans to list on the Australia and New Zealand stock exchanges on May 19 and plans to use money raised in the float to fund the previously announced buyout of its Asian partner, Jardine Pacific.
Colonial estimated its market capitalisation at the retail bid price would total about A$1.5 billion.
In its prospectus, Colonial, Australia's third largest life office, forecast a net profit of A$180 million for calendar 1997 from A$120 million in 1996.
